versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: צַ֚ו אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֶת־קָרְבָּנִ֨י לַחְמִ֜י לְאִשַּׁ֗י רֵ֚יחַ נִֽיחֹחִ֔י תִּשְׁמְר֕וּ לְהַקְרִ֥יב לִ֖י בְּמוֹעֲדֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’
controles.kjv: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
controles.livre: Manda aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Da minha oferta, do meu pão com as minhas ofertas de queima em cheiro a mim agradável, tereis cuidado, para as oferecer a mim no tempo devido.

versos.hebraico: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם זֶ֚ה הָֽאִשֶּׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ לַיהוָ֑ה כְּבָשִׂ֨ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֧ה תְמִימִ֛ם שְׁנַ֥יִם לַיּ֖וֹם עֹלָ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃

controles.web: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the Lord; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
controles.livre: E lhes dirás: Esta é a oferta de queima que oferecereis ao SENHOR: dois cordeiros sem mácula de ano, cada dia, será o holocausto contínuo.

versos.hebraico: אֶת־הַכֶּ֥בֶשׂ אֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַבֹּ֑קֶר וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָֽעַרְבָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening;
controles.kjv: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
controles.livre: Um cordeiro oferecerás pela manhã, e o outro cordeiro oferecerás entre as duas tardes:

versos.hebraico: וַעֲשִׂירִ֧ית הָאֵיפָ֛ה סֹ֖לֶת לְמִנְחָ֑ה בְּלוּלָ֛ה בְּשֶׁ֥מֶן כָּתִ֖ית רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִֽין׃

controles.web: with the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
controles.kjv: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
controles.livre: E a décima de um efa de flor de farinha, amassada com uma quarta parte de um him de azeite prensado, em oferta de cereais.

versos.hebraico: עֹלַ֖ת תָּמִ֑יד הָעֲשֻׂיָה֙ בְּהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
controles.livre: É holocausto contínuo, que foi feito no monte Sinai em cheiro suave, oferta de queima ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְנִסְכּוֹ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ת הַהִ֔ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד בַּקֹּ֗דֶשׁ הַסֵּ֛ךְ נֶ֥סֶךְ שֵׁכָ֖ר לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.
controles.kjv: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the Lord for a drink offering.
controles.livre: E sua libação, a quarta parte de um him com cada cordeiro: derramarás libação de superior vinho ao SENHOR no santuário.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָֽעַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּמִנְחַ֨ת הַבֹּ֤קֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E oferecerás o segundo cordeiro entre as duas tardes: conforme a oferta da manhã, e conforme sua libação oferecerás, oferta de queima em cheiro suave ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וּבְיוֹם֙ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת שְׁנֵֽי־כְבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֖ה תְּמִימִ֑ם וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֧לֶת מִנְחָ֛ה בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “‘On the Sabbath day, two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
controles.kjv: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
controles.livre: Mas no dia do sábado dois cordeiros de ano sem defeito, e duas dízimas de flor de farinha amassada com azeite, por oferta de cereais, com sua libação:

versos.hebraico: עֹלַ֥ת שַׁבַּ֖ת בְּשַׁבַּתּ֑וֹ עַל־עֹלַ֥ת הַתָּמִ֖יד וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ס

controles.web: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
controles.kjv: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
controles.livre: É o holocausto do sábado em cada sábado, além do holocausto contínuo e sua libação.

versos.hebraico: וּבְרָאשֵׁי֙ חָדְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ עֹלָ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה פָּרִ֨ים בְּנֵֽי־בָקָ֤ר שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ וְאַ֣יִל אֶחָ֔ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃

controles.web: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
controles.kjv: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
controles.livre: E nos princípios de vossos meses oferecereis em holocausto ao SENHOR dois bezerros das vacas, e um carneiro, e sete cordeiros de ano sem defeito;

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לַפָּ֖ר הָאֶחָ֑ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לָאַ֖יִל הָֽאֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: and three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
controles.kjv: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
controles.livre: E três dízimas de flor de farinha amassada com azeite, por oferta de cereais com cada bezerro; e duas dízimas de flor de farinha amassada com azeite, por oferta de cereais com cada carneiro;

versos.hebraico: וְעִשָּׂרֹ֣ן עִשָּׂר֗וֹן סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד עֹלָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: and a tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb; for a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E uma dízima de flor de farinha amassada com azeite, em oferta de cereais com cada cordeiro: holocausto de cheiro suave, oferta de queima ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם חֲצִ֣י הַהִין֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לַפָּ֜ר וּשְׁלִישִׁ֧ת הַהִ֣ין לָאַ֗יִל וּרְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִ֛ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ יָ֑יִן זֹ֣את עֹלַ֥ת חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ בְּחָדְשׁ֔וֹ לְחָדְשֵׁ֖י הַשָּׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
controles.kjv: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
controles.livre: E suas libações de vinho, meio him com cada bezerro, e o terço de um him com cada carneiro, e a quarta parte de um him com cada cordeiro. Este é o holocausto de cada mês por todos os meses do ano.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׂעִ֨יר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֛ד לְחַטָּ֖את לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־עֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: One male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
controles.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the Lord shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
controles.livre: E um bode macho em expiação se oferecerá ao SENHOR, além do holocausto contínuo com sua libação.

versos.hebraico: וּבַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ פֶּ֖סַח לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.
controles.kjv: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the Lord.
controles.livre: Mas no mês primeiro, aos catorze do mês será a páscoa do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֖ה חָ֑ג שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל׃

controles.web: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten be eaten for seven days.
controles.kjv: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
controles.livre: E aos quinze dias deste mês, a solenidade: por sete dias se comerão pães ázimos.

versos.hebraico: בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן מִקְרָא־קֹ֑דֶשׁ כָּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

controles.web: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;
controles.kjv: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:
controles.livre: No primeiro dia, santa convocação; nenhuma obra servil fareis:

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם וְאַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד וְשִׁבְעָ֤ה כְבָשִׂים֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without defect;
controles.kjv: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
controles.livre: E oferecereis por oferta de queima em holocausto ao SENHOR dois bezerros das vacas, e um carneiro, e sete cordeiros de ano: sem defeito os tomareis:

versos.hebraico: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֗ר וּשְׁנֵ֧י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֛ים לָאַ֖יִל תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃

controles.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenth parts for a bull, and two tenth parts for the ram.
controles.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
controles.livre: E sua oferta de cereais de farinha amassada com azeite: três dízimas com cada bezerro, e duas dízimas com cada carneiro oferecereis;

versos.hebraico: עִשָּׂר֤וֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃

controles.web: You shall offer a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;
controles.kjv: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
controles.livre: Com cada um dos sete cordeiros oferecereis uma dízima;

versos.hebraico: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
controles.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
controles.livre: E um bode macho por expiação, para reconciliar-vos.

versos.hebraico: מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַבֹּ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֑יד תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת־אֵֽלֶּה׃

controles.web: You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
controles.kjv: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
controles.livre: Isto oferecereis além do holocausto da manhã, que é o holocausto contínuo.

versos.hebraico: כָּאֵ֜לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֤וּ לַיּוֹם֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים לֶ֛חֶם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־עוֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.
controles.kjv: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
controles.livre: Conforme isto oferecereis cada um dos sete dias, comida e oferta de queima em cheiro suave ao SENHOR; oferecer-se há, além do holocausto contínuo, com sua libação.

versos.hebraico: וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִקְרָא־קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ס

controles.web: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
controles.kjv: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
controles.livre: E no sétimo dia tereis santa convocação: nenhuma obra servil fareis.

versos.hebraico: וּבְי֣וֹם הַבִּכּוּרִ֗ים בְּהַקְרִ֨יבְכֶ֜ם מִנְחָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּשָׁבֻעֹ֖תֵיכֶ֑ם מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

controles.web: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;
controles.kjv: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the Lord, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
controles.livre: Também o dia das primícias, quando oferecerdes oferta de cereais nova ao SENHOR em vossas semanas, tereis santa convocação: nenhuma obra servil fareis:

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עוֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד שִׁבְעָ֥ה כְבָשִׂ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;
controles.kjv: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
controles.livre: E oferecereis em holocausto, em cheiro suave ao SENHOR, dois bezerros das vacas, um carneiro, sete cordeiros de ano:

versos.hebraico: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֔ד שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָאַ֖יִל הָאֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for each bull, two tenth parts for the one ram,
controles.kjv: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
controles.livre: E a oferta de cereais deles, flor de farinha amassada com azeite, três dízimas com cada bezerro, duas dízimas com cada carneiro,

versos.hebraico: עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃

controles.web: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;
controles.kjv: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
controles.livre: Com cada um dos sete cordeiros uma dízima;

versos.hebraico: שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים אֶחָ֑ד לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: one male goat, to make atonement for you.
controles.kjv: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
controles.livre: Um bode macho, para fazer expiação por vós.

versos.hebraico: מִלְּבַ֞ד עֹלַ֧ת הַתָּמִ֛יד וּמִנְחָת֖וֹ תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיוּ־לָכֶ֖ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: Besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.
controles.kjv: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
controles.livre: Os oferecereis, além do holocausto contínuo com suas ofertas de cereais, e suas libações: sem defeito os tomareis.
